# nxos_vtp (Resource)

This resource can manage the VTP (VLAN Trunking Protocol) configuration on NX-OS devices, including domain, mode, version, password and VLAN database file settings.

### API Documentation

- [vtpEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Entity/)
- [vtpInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Inst/)
- [vtpIntf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Intf/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_vtp" "example" {
  admin_state          = "enabled"
  instance_admin_state = "enabled"
  domain               = "DOMAIN1"
  file_path            = "bootflash:/vtp.dat"
  mode                 = "server"
  password             = "secret_password"
  version              = 2
  interfaces = {
    "eth1/9" = {
      admin_state = "disabled"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `domain` (String) domain.
- `file_path` (String) file.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of VTP interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Id (eg: eth1/3) of L2 interface which has VTP enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `mode` (String) mode.
  - Choices: `client`, `server`, `transparent`, `off`
- `password` (String, Sensitive) password.
- `password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `version` (Number) version.
  - Range: `1`-`2`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Optional:

- `admin_state` (String) Admin state of L2 interface which has VTP enabled.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_vtp.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_vtp for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_vtp.example ""
```
